matchInput: I want to open a teashop
aliases: I want to open a tea shop
disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for the teashop's logo and signage
steps.why: The name and logo get reused on signage, the menu, and social media, so brand work comes first to avoid re-doing anything.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for the shop and food shots
steps.why: Photos of the space and what you serve are the base assets for the Facebook page. One shoot after the brand is set covers everything.

steps.title: Hire a social media manager for the Facebook page
steps.why: Facebook is the most effective channel for reaching local customers. Regular posts around opening and daily promotions need a monthly plan.

steps.title: Engage a company-registration specialist for legal setup
steps.why: Registration and licensing paperwork should be handled with an appropriate professional. This step names the professional type only — it is not advice.
